verdicts.why: The row glosses あまり, which is in the seed's あまり珍しくありません. The target '(not) very' is a parenthesised gloss of 'not very', so the seed's 'not very' is a plausible fix. 'Very' alone is the sibling LEGO's target, so the intended value is not forced.
The を particle in あなたを待つ is a real part of the sentence, and '(object marker)' is a grammatical label that the English 'I'm not going to wait for you' does not render.
を in 女性を is in the seed's known sentence, and '(object marker)' is a grammatical label with no counterpart in 'I know an old woman who can remember the answer'.
いく is in うまくいく, and its gloss 'go (→ turn out)' is a literal gloss of a word the seed renders as 'it will work'.
〜た is the past ending inside 良かった, and 'past' is a grammatical label; the seed's 'It was nice' has no separate word for it.
います is in 似ています, and 'are' is a literal gloss. The seed 'you're like' has the contraction "you're", so 'are' is not a contiguous substring.
知りません is the non-past form of 知りませんでした, which is in the seed. "don't know" is a present-tense form of the seed's "didn't know".
わかりません is in the seed, but 'I don't understand' is a literal gloss. The seed renders it as "we don't know", so the subject differs and the row cannot be fixed to a single value.
わかりません is in 全然わかりません, and "I don't understand" is a literal gloss. The seed renders the phrase as "I don't have the faintest idea".
くる is the lemma of 置いてきた, which is in the seed. 'came' is a literal gloss of that, and the seed renders the whole as 'left'.
いかない is in うまくいかない, and 'not going' is a literal gloss. The seed renders the whole as "it's not working".
に in 前に is a real part of the seed. 'at/in' is a literal gloss that the seed's 'earlier' does not render separately.
しなかった is in しなかったでしょう, and "didn't do" is a literal gloss of it. The seed renders the phrase as "wouldn't have said".
ような is in 似たような, and 'like' is a literal gloss. The seed renders it as 'similar'.
うまく is in うまくいく, and 'well/successfully' is a literal gloss. The seed renders the phrase as 'it will work'.
うまく is in うまくいかない, and 'well' is a literal gloss. The seed renders the phrase as "it's not working".
は is in は何ですか, and 'topic particle' is a grammatical label. The seed's "what's" has no separate word for it.
時間 is in 今朝起きたかった時間, which is in the seed. 'time' is not a substring of 'I woke earlier than I wanted to this morning', which does not render 時間.
